ledger.title: The checker-plugin firewall still folds plugin answers into the host's unit row instead of contributing external-checker components
ledger.why: Card AUDIT-COMPOSITION published the integration semigroup (qcore_schemas::composition; spec L21.2 'Composition across results') and made the audit report's unit rows a derived view over per-row components, but only host components exist: user_plugins::fold_unit and qcore_verifier_host::plugin_firewall still join a plugin's answer into the host row before it is recorded, so a checker's contribution cannot be removed or audited apart from the host's. DISCHARGE: the firewall emits one Component per plugin answer with Provenance.external_checker set (plugin id, version, binary digest), the host row stays the host's component, the published row is Contribution::derive over both, and an identity run shows every report without plugin bindings byte-identical while a plugin-bound fixture derives the same status it publishes today.

ledger.title: The contract loader unions bundles outside the composition interface
ledger.why: Seam G makes the semigroup the only integration path for results and contracts. Card AUDIT-COMPOSITION built the results half; contract bundles still enter the environment through the loader's own union with a hard duplicate error, and the components' provenance records one 'resource-contracts' digest of the loaded environment rather than per-bundle digests. Supersession by pin stamp is the separate card CONTRACT-SUPERSESSION. DISCHARGE: the loader records one digest per provider bundle and the report's components carry them in Provenance.contract_bundles (so withdrawing a bundle is a removal over components), landed with or after CONTRACT-SUPERSESSION, with an identity run.

ledger.title: MEASURE-TOOL must compose and compare through qcore_schemas::composition, as a quirin-audit subcommand
ledger.why: Seam F's measurement tool (user decision 8: a quirin-audit subcommand plugin) is the intended consumer of the component sidecars card AUDIT-COMPOSITION writes beside every unit report (<report>.components.json, ComponentSidecar). Published baselines should store these components, a profile total is a derivation over them, and a rule's contribution is attribution by Contribution::remove, never a summed total. DISCHARGE: quirin-audit measure reads both sides' sidecars, composes a baseline with a TIP contribution through Contribution::union, reports conflicts (composition-conflict) and per-row derivation changes as its native-comparison record, and its tests reuse the shared vectors of proof/QCore/AuditComposition.lean.

ledger.title: Property rows (null, bounds, outer projection) and checkpoint-composed reports carry no components
ledger.why: Card AUDIT-COMPOSITION componentizes the unit rows written through AuditReport::write_with_revision_key (pinned, current, configured and contracts-only routes). The checkpoint-composed report (compose.rs, streamed from .qo checkpoints) writes no sidecar, and the null/bounds/outer-projection rows and their summaries are written directly. DISCHARGE: each of these writers derives its rows from a ComponentSidecar as the unit report does, each with an identity run, the checkpoint route's sidecar byte-equal to the uncheckpointed route's.

ledger.title: The contract sidecar's lifetime-source unit identities depend on the minute Monkey's monkey.c was preprocessed
ledger.why: qcore_c_gateway::loop_lifetime_source::read_unit names a unit by the SHA-256 of its preprocessing options and preprocessed text, and Fluent Bit's lib/monkey/mk_bin/monkey.c expands __DATE__ and __TIME__. Card AUDIT-COMPOSITION's identity runs measured it: in resource-diagnostics.contracts.json (callback_members/lifetime_protocols/evidence/summaries and the prepass copy) exactly one key changes between any two runs of the same binary (runs 2 and 3 of the same BASE code disagree; BASE and TIP started together agree), on the corpus, slice and system routes alike. Every identity run must therefore special-case this key, and a published digest carries the wall clock. DISCHARGE: preprocess the lifetime-source read with fixed __DATE__/__TIME__ (or hash the text with those expansions normalised), so two runs of one binary write byte-identical contract sidecars, with a test that preprocesses a unit using both macros twice.

ledger.title: A component's analyzer revision is package@version plus an optional build commit, not the binary digest
ledger.why: report_components::analyzer_revision (card AUDIT-COMPOSITION) spells qcore-audit@<version>:<QCORE_AUDIT_BUILD_COMMIT or unrecorded-build>. Two different builds without a recorded commit share a provenance key, so joining their contributions surfaces as composition-conflict (fail-closed) rather than as two producers. DISCHARGE: put the analyzer binary's SHA-256 (as checkpoint_run::run_identity takes it) or a mandatory build commit into Provenance, with a test that two differing binaries never share a provenance key.
